1use crate::third_party::krilla::text::Font;
2use crate::third_party::krilla::text::{GlyphId, KrillaGlyph};
3use rustybuzz::ttf_parser::Tag;
4use rustybuzz::{Direction, UnicodeBuffer};
5
6/// Naively shape some text with a single font.
7pub(crate) fn naive_shape(text: &str, font: Font, direction: TextDirection) -> Vec<KrillaGlyph> {
8    let data = font.font_data();
9    let mut rb_font = rustybuzz::Face::from_slice(data.as_ref(), font.index()).unwrap();
10
11    for variation in font.variation_coordinates() {
12        rb_font.set_variation(Tag::from_bytes(variation.0.get()), variation.1.get());
13    }
14
15    let mut buffer = UnicodeBuffer::new();
16    buffer.push_str(text);
17    buffer.guess_segment_properties();
18
19    match direction {
20        TextDirection::LeftToRight => buffer.set_direction(Direction::LeftToRight),
21        TextDirection::RightToLeft => buffer.set_direction(Direction::RightToLeft),
22        TextDirection::TopToBottom => buffer.set_direction(Direction::TopToBottom),
23        TextDirection::BottomToTop => buffer.set_direction(Direction::BottomToTop),
24        TextDirection::Auto => {}
25    }
26
27    let dir = buffer.direction();
28
29    let output = rustybuzz::shape(&rb_font, &[], buffer);
30
31    let positions = output.glyph_positions();
32    let infos = output.glyph_infos();
33
34    let mut glyphs = vec![];
35
36    for i in 0..output.len() {
37        let pos = positions[i];
38        let start_info = infos[i];
39
40        let start = start_info.cluster as usize;
41
42        let end = if dir == Direction::LeftToRight || dir == Direction::TopToBottom {
43            let mut e = i.checked_add(1);
44            loop {
45                if let Some(index) = e {
46                    if let Some(end_info) = infos.get(index) {
47                        if end_info.cluster == start_info.cluster {
48                            e = index.checked_add(1);
49                            continue;
50                        }
51                    }
52                }
53
54                break;
55            }
56
57            e
58        } else {
59            let mut e = i.checked_sub(1);
60            while let Some(index) = e {
61                if let Some(end_info) = infos.get(index) {
62                    if end_info.cluster == start_info.cluster {
63                        e = index.checked_sub(1);
64                    } else {
65                        break;
66                    }
67                }
68            }
69
70            e
71        }
72        .and_then(|last| infos.get(last))
73        .map_or(text.len(), |info| info.cluster as usize);
74
75        glyphs.push(KrillaGlyph::new(
76            GlyphId::new(start_info.glyph_id),
77            pos.x_advance as f32 / font.units_per_em(),
78            pos.x_offset as f32 / font.units_per_em(),
79            pos.y_offset as f32 / font.units_per_em(),
80            pos.y_advance as f32 / font.units_per_em(),
81            start..end,
82            None,
83        ));
84    }
85
86    glyphs
87}
88
89/// The direction of a text.
90#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
91pub enum TextDirection {
92    /// Determine the direction automatically.
93    Auto,
94    /// Left to right.
95    LeftToRight,
96    /// Right to left.
97    RightToLeft,
98    /// Top to bottom.
99    TopToBottom,
100    /// Bottom to top.
101    BottomToTop,
102}
